lessons.title: AC Power Flow Solvers & Newton-Raphson Implementations
lessons.summary: Review PYPOWER, MATPOWER, Pandapower, and PowerModels.jl for bus admittance matrix formulation and nonlinear power flow convergence.
checkpoints: Compare convergence speed across Python, MATLAB, and Julia

lessons.title: Optimal Power Flow (OPF) & Security-Constrained Dispatch
lessons.summary: Formulate generator cost curve minimization subject to line thermal transmission limits and bus voltage bounds (N-1 security).
checkpoints: Verify all bus voltages within 0.95 to 1.05 p.u.

lessons.title: Production Cost Modeling (PCM) & Long-Term Generation Expansion
lessons.summary: Explore open-source models (Sienna, PyPSA, Switch) for 8760-hour unit commitment, startup/shutdown costs, and renewable curtailment.
checkpoints: Quantify economic curtailment of solar and wind assets
Analyze battery storage capacity expansion payback

lessons.title: Electromagnetic Transient (EMT) vs. Phasor-Domain Simulators
lessons.summary: Differentiate transient stability tools (PSSE/PowerWorld equivalents) from microsecond EMT engines (OpenDSS, Simscape Electrical).
checkpoints: Identify high-frequency control interactions invisible in phasor domain
Select optimal simulation toolchain for target engineering project
